Corollary
[distributional comparison for reduced distance] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 3.2.4\group Cao–Zhu Comparison Theorems for Perelman’s Reduced Volume We have \[ \Delta L\leq rac{n}{\sqrt{ ar{ au }}} -2\sqrt{ ar{ au }}R- rac{1}{ ar{ au }}K \] in the sense of distribution. Moreover, the equality holds if and only if we are on a gradient shrinking soliton with \[ R_{ij}+ rac{1}{2\sqrt{ ar au }} abla _i abla _jL = rac{1}{2 ar au }g_{ij}. \]

Proof

↗ prop:cz-l-jacobi-comparison-inequality \sketch Sum the preceding Hessian estimate over the transported orthonormal frame; its equality case is the shrinking-soliton equation.
